name: raise a doggo 🐶 [THE OUTSIDE UPDATE]
desc:
welcome to raise a doggo 🐶

in this game you raise a doggo™, click doggo to get doggo coins, buy food and feed him, buy new upgrades to make more money, look at your doggo slowly grow and live happily with your funny doggo

feed him or he will starve to death

btw for all raise a floppa fans that are wondering where the save game button is, the game saves automatically.
